title: skills(objectstack-ui): the compareTo section does not say a compare widget's date key must be the name of a declared date dimension
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUg7BKfRBcTPyMxbLh

Filing gate ③: area-directed (area S2 of seat domain:server#5). Finding S2 of the L2 contract review 6909901648 on PR #34198 (card #34005).

## Today

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`, section "Period-over-period — `compareTo`", teaches `compareTo: { kind, dimension? }` and says nothing about the date key. With PR #34198, a dataset query refuses any member the dataset does not declare. That includes the time dimension a compare widget's date window is lowered into, which is named after the dashboard date-range field (`dateRange.field`, default `created_at`). An agent authoring from this skill can produce a compare widget whose date-range field is not also the name of a declared date dimension. That widget is refused at render, and no save gate stops it first (#34308).

## Ask

In that section, add the rule and the remedy as #34198 lands them: a compare widget's date window travels as a time dimension named after the date-range field, so the dataset must declare a date dimension with that name. Match the wording of `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` "The Date Key of a Compare Widget" after #34198 merges, and run the skills gates.

Blocked-by: #34198 (the rule and its final remedy wording).

Reader: domain:skills. Size XS.
